item.title: As former athletes, some Senators have extra say on the college sports reform bill
item.description: As Senate considers a major college sports reform bill lobbied for by the NCAA and other powerful stakeholders, some lawmakers — themselves former college athletes — have a major say in the debate.

item.title: Ohio governor's race: Ramaswamy and Acton clash in rare Democratic pickup opportunity
item.description: The Ohio governor's race pits Vivek Ramaswamy against Democrat Amy Acton. While Ramaswamy downplays his Trump tie and Acton faces pandemic-era scrutiny, Democrats eye a rare win in 40 years

item.title: Politics chat: Trump vs the media; rolling back health and education spending
item.description: We look at President Trump's fight with some of the White House press corps, as well as his attempt to claw back $810 million in Congressionally-approved funds for health and education spending.

item.title: These Democrats are running for Congress on Christian faith. Will it pay off?
item.description: It's rare for Democrats to make religion a centerpiece of their campaigns. But this midterm election cycle, a number of candidates for Congress are doing just that.

item.title: Trump calls Iranian plan to reopen Strait of Hormuz not 'acceptable'
item.description: President Trump said he was rejecting an Iranian plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The Iranian proposal is similar to a memorandum of understanding agreed upon by the U.S. and Iran back in June.

item.title: Press pool dispute escalates as White House cuts CNN from Air Force One travel
item.description: The White House has barred CNN from traveling on Air Force One this weekend. It's another chapter in President Trump's fight with the press, and it appears there will be no TV pool coverage today.

item.title: Supreme Court rejects GOP-backed Missouri map, preserving key seat for Democrats
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court rejected a Republican attempt at redistricting congressional seats in Missouri - possibly giving Democrats a boost in their effort to win the House in the midterm elections.

item.description: Some GOP candidates are stepping back from unpopular Trump administration policies. Meanwhile, a U.S.-China summit at the White House and tensions with the press corps.

item.title: Battle for the Lehigh Valley: Can GOP hold its razor-thin margin?
item.description: Both parties target the Lehigh Valley for House control. While the GOP made inroads with Latinos, Dems argue Trump's immigration stance hurts them. Can Republicans hold this 1% margin swing seat?

item.title: The U.S. has more thalidomide survivors than the government admits
item.description: In the 1950s and 1960s, doctors gave the drug thalidomide to pregnant patients without telling them — and without FDA approval. Now those patients' children want recognition.
